title: The First Rota
body: Tamsin Orrell, a cutter from the second berth, asks for a fair shift rota. The crews are working until they drop.

choices.label: Agree to the rota (Union +10, morale +3)
Production comes first (Company +5, Union -10)

title: An Inspector Calls
body: A Harrow & Vell inspector walks the colony with a clipboard. He wants to know when the first shipments will go up.

choices.label: Promise faster shipments (Company +10, Union -5)
Show him the shortages (Company -5, Union +5)

title: A Place to Meet
body: The crews ask for a hall of their own: somewhere warm to meet, argue and vote.

choices.label: Give 30 alloy for a hall (Union +15, morale +5)
Not now (Union -10)

title: The Company Store
body: Harrow & Vell offer to open a store at the landing pad. They will pay the colony a fee, and sell to the crews at Company prices.

choices.label: Allow the store (+150 marks, Company +10, Union -10, morale -3)
Refuse (Company -10, Union +5)

title: The Inspector Returns
body: The inspector is back, and he remembers your promise.

choices.label: Pay a goodwill bonus of 200 marks (Company +10)
Ask for patience (Company -10)

title: Accident on the Seam
body: A cutter rig slipped its anchors. Two of the crew are badly hurt. Their families are waiting for the colony's answer.

choices.label: Compensate the families, 100 marks (Union +10)
Call it the crew's own fault (Union -15, Company +5)

title: Letters to Other Colonies
body: The Union wants to write to the other charter colonies, to compare terms and wages. The Company would not approve.

choices.label: Send the letters (Union +10, Company -10)
Keep quiet (Company +5, Union -5)

title: A Warning from the Board
body: A sealed message from the Harrow & Vell board: relations have soured, and an audit is being discussed.

choices.label: Pay a 300-mark settlement (Company +15)
Stand firm (Company -10, Union +10)

title: Strike
body: The crews have downed tools. Nobody works until the colony listens.

choices.label: Meet their demands: 100 marks (Union +20, morale +5)
Wait it out: no work for 3 turns (Union -5)

title: The Assembly
body: The whole colony crowds into the hall. The Union has a motion: the charter is unjust, and the colony should declare itself free of the Company, debt and all.

choices.label: Not yet (Union -10)
Declare the colony free (ends the game)

title: A Generous Offer
body: The Harrow & Vell board are pleased with you. They offer to cancel the debt, if the colony becomes Company property, with you as its manager.

choices.label: Keep the charter (Company -10)
Sign the colony over (ends the game)

title: Lichen Bloom
body: After the frost melts, a pale green lichen spreads across the plains round the colony. The botanists think it could be eaten, once treated.

choices.label: Harvest and treat it (+40 food, morale +2)
Let it grow: the crews like having green to look at (morale +6)

title: A Quiet Place
body: Word has spread that Tessel is gentle. A family ship asks to join the colony.

choices.label: Welcome them (+6 adults, Company -5)
Send them on to the Company's port (Company +5)

title: Cliff Fall
body: A tremor shears a slab off a ridge. It tumbles across the plain, scattering rubble and fresh ore.

choices.label: Clear it up and keep the ore (+30 ore, a building is damaged)
Fence it off and let the dust settle (a rest day, morale +2)

title: The Crystal Cave
body: Cutters break into a hollow lined with glittering crystal.

choices.label: Sell the crystals (+250 marks, Union -5)
Keep it as a place to visit (morale +8, Union +5)

title: Eruption
body: A cone to the west erupts. Ash rains down and the vents roar.

choices.label: Seal up and ride it out (an ash storm; vents surge)
Send crews out to keep the panels clear (morale -4, Union -5)

title: Glass Fields
body: Lava has cooled into fields of black glass near the colony. It smelts into fine alloy.

choices.label: Smelt it (+40 alloy, Company +5)
Leave it: the crews say it brings luck (Union +8, morale +3)

title: Lights Under the Ice
body: Something glows far below the ice: drifting lights, slow and silent. Probably minerals. Probably.

choices.label: Send a probe down (-5 parts, morale +4)
Leave them be (morale -2: people keep watching)

title: The Warm Current
body: The probe found a warm current flowing under the ice, close to the colony.

choices.label: Tap it (+60 water; vents surge)
Leave it for now (morale +3)

title: The Long Dark
body: Rimefar's star slips behind a dust lane. For a while, even noon is night.

choices.label: Ration power and keep spirits up (morale -3; a long dark)
Burn reserves for light and warmth (-20 alloy, morale +3; a long dark)

title: A Beacon at the Edge
body: A faint signal: the beacon of a survey team lost years ago. Their supply cache is close by.

choices.label: Fetch the cache (+30 food, +30 oxygen, +10 parts)
Report it to the Company (Company +10, debt -100)

title: Thaw Season
body: The thaw line drifts east for a season. Ice near the colony softens to slush, and water is easy to come by.

choices.label: Fill every tank (+60 water)
Let the crews swim in the melt pools (morale +6)

title: Solar Flare
body: A flare from Cinder's star washes over the colony. Instruments crackle and spark.

choices.label: Shelter the crews (a rest day, morale +2)
Keep working through it (+20 alloy, a building is damaged)

title: Aurora
body: Faint green lights ripple across Hollow's sky: the first colour anyone has seen in months.

choices.label: Declare a holiday (a rest day, morale +8)
Watch from work (morale +3)
